crops.name: Rice (lowland)
crops.farmer_tip: Level the field and keep 3-5 cm of water in early growth; use certified seed.

crops.name: Salt-tolerant rice
crops.farmer_tip: Check salinity before planting and sow when river salinity is low.

crops.name: Maize
crops.farmer_tip: Split nitrogen into 2-3 doses and scout for fall armyworm early.

crops.name: Soybean
crops.farmer_tip: Inoculate seed with rhizobium on fields new to soybean; watch for rust.

crops.name: Groundnut (peanut)
crops.farmer_tip: Add phosphorus and lime or gypsum on sandy soil; dry pods fully to avoid aflatoxin.

crops.name: Green gram (mung bean)
crops.farmer_tip: Sow evenly so pods ripen together and harvest before heavy rain.

crops.name: Black gram
crops.farmer_tip: Good after rice on leftover moisture; control yellow mosaic virus carriers (whitefly).

crops.name: Cowpea
crops.farmer_tip: Cut green stems as fodder or green manure after harvesting the seed.

crops.name: Pigeon pea
crops.farmer_tip: Slow early growth, so intercrop with sesame or groundnut and weed early.

crops.name: Chickpea
crops.farmer_tip: Sow soon after the monsoon while soil is moist; treat seed against wilt.

crops.name: Sesame
crops.farmer_tip: Thin early, avoid waterlogging, harvest when lower capsules turn yellow.

crops.name: Sunflower
crops.farmer_tip: Protect heads from birds and avoid flowering in the wettest weeks.

crops.name: Sorghum
crops.farmer_tip: A good cereal break after legumes; scare birds near harvest.

crops.name: Cassava
crops.farmer_tip: Use disease-free stakes, add organic matter, and sell roots within 1-2 days of harvest.

crops.name: Sugarcane
crops.farmer_tip: Only worthwhile within reach of a mill; legumes between cycles rebuild soil.

crops.name: Potato
crops.farmer_tip: Use certified seed tubers, hill the soil, and watch for late blight.

crops.name: Watermelon
crops.farmer_tip: Mulch and use drip irrigation; do not repeat on the same bed.

crops.name: Mixed vegetables
crops.farmer_tip: Choose short crops near a market and rotate plant families.

crops.name: Cashew
crops.farmer_tip: Slow to bear (3+ years); intercrop young trees with legumes.

crops.name: Sunn hemp (green manure)
crops.farmer_tip: Plough in at flowering (about 45-60 days) to build organic matter.

crops.name: Legume cover crop (e.g. Pueraria)
crops.farmer_tip: Keep a strip clear around young trees so the cover does not smother them.

crops.name: Pineapple
crops.farmer_tip: Needs well-drained soil; plant on raised beds and mulch.

crops.name: Sweet potato
crops.farmer_tip: Use cuttings from healthy vines; avoid waterlogged soil.

crops.name: Oil palm
crops.farmer_tip: Plantation crop with about 3 years to first harvest; cover-crop young rows.

crops.name: Rubber
crops.farmer_tip: Tapping needs skilled labour and prices swing.
